name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux from PyPI through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc23): workgroups on the Company Tree can be MOVED. Building one and deleting one already worked; nothing could reparent an existing workgroup, because the Move button opens a picker dialog rather than acting on its own. You can now move a workgroup under another, or promote it back to the top level. It refuses the three moves that would leave you without a tree - a workgroup under itself, or under one of its own children - and checks the result in the database rather than trusting the screen. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
